name: crew-board
description: Plan and subagent progress above the prompt, plus a crew panel (/crew): running, finished and planned subagents with model, steps, context, tokens and time.

showMascot.title: Show the mendako
showMascot.description: Draw the mendako on the band and the panel's cards; off, their room goes to the text

language.title: Language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale, then English

autoOpen.title: Open the crew panel
autoOpen.description: plan: when a plan is reported; any: also when any subagent starts

contextWarnPercent.title: Context warning (%)
contextWarnPercent.description: Show a toast once per subagent when its context fill goes over this percentage

tokenBudget.title: Token budget per subagent
tokenBudget.description: Tokens one subagent may use before its token bar turns yellow (75%) and red (100%); 0 compares runs with each other and never warns

stepInclude.title: Ask these plugin agents for steps
stepInclude.description: Comma-separated agent types with a ":" (plugin agents) whose brief still gets the step request

stepExclude.title: Never ask these agents for steps
stepExclude.description: Comma-separated agent types whose brief never gets the step request
